in_greek.name: Κιμβλης
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Kimble in Greek originates from the word 'κιμβλη', which means 'helmet' or 'headgear'. This name may have been given to someone who wore a helmet in battle, or it could have been a symbolic name indicating strength, protection, or leadership.

in_latin.name: Cymbulus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Kimble in Latin is translated as 'Cymbulus'. It is derived from the Latin word 'cymbalum', which means 'helmet' or 'cymbal'. This name could have been given to someone who wore a helmet in battle or to someone who played the cymbal as a musical instrument.
